stories.title: The Missing Supply Convoy
stories.brief: Dawnspire's Crownheart is missing. Help Eryn find the village supply convoy; its route may reveal who is moving through the forest.
stories.outcome: The supplies identify the missing convoy. A cloth signal leads to survivors beside the broken cart.

stories.title: Friends to the Rescue
stories.brief: Bring the recovered medicine to the survivors, rescue their missing driver, and mark the road to camp.
stories.outcome: The survivors and driver are on the safe camp route. Tell Selene the rescue is complete, then follow the driver's watchtower clue.

stories.title: New Friends at Camp
stories.brief: Report the rescue to Selene and plan the missing workers' rescue with Eryn. Selene's recruitment is free; story support is separate.
stories.outcome: Selene is recruited. The driver's signal sketch gives Eryn a route to the watchtower and its captive forest friend.

stories.title: The Watchtower Rescue
stories.brief: Disable the watchtower devices, free the captive forest friend, and reconnect the camp signal.
stories.outcome: Your forest friend has a safe way home. The restored signal and raiders' map reveal cages in the occupied ruins.

stories.title: Bring the Workers Home
stories.brief: Free the convoy workers, stop the barracks signal, and defeat the Orc Warlord blocking their escape.
stories.outcome: The workers are safe. King Shaman's orders lead through a threatened forest village to the Black Root Altar.

stories.title: A Safe Path for Everyone
stories.brief: Help the forest families disable the root devices and mark a route safe for residents and rescuers alike.
stories.outcome: The families have a way back to camp. Their marked rootway leads to King Shaman's altar.

stories.title: The Forest Is Safe Again
stories.brief: Defeat King Shaman, close the local monster portal, and check the stolen Crownheart's delivery orders.
stories.outcome: The supply convoy is home and the altar portal is closed. The Crownheart cargo went into Gloamwood; Eryn's scouts followed and have not returned.

stories.title: Supplies in the Marsh
stories.brief: Recover the convoy's waterproof list so the survivors can account for their missing supplies and workers.
stories.outcome: The survivors have their supply record and names list. They can account for the recovered stores and the workers who returned.

stories.title: The Stolen Food
stories.brief: Recover Liora's stolen food and free the captives so the rescued camp can share a proper meal.
stories.outcome: The recovered food reaches Liora's camp table. The rescued travelers prepare a proper meal together.

stories.title: Quarry Below the Falls
stories.brief: Inspect the quarry transport gear and secure a hauling route the outpost workers can use again.
stories.outcome: Fen has the quarry findings. The old hauling route can help the outpost recover its supplies.

stories.title: Remnants of the Red Battlefield
stories.brief: After the altar is closed, follow the missing scout's trail and stop the separate warband at the old battlefield.
stories.outcome: The scout returns and Eryn records the safe route. This remaining warband cannot reopen King Shaman's closed altar portal.

stories.title: Lantern Trail
stories.brief: Help Maeve separate the Crownheart cargo trail from the missing scouts' rescue marks.
stories.outcome: The cargo wheels continue north, but the scout marks turn into the webs. Finn is waiting near the trapped Tali.

stories.title: A Light in the Webs
stories.brief: Help Finn hold a light for Tali, cut her bindings, and prepare her safe return.
stories.outcome: Tali is free and confirms the cargo passed ahead of the scouts. Escort her to Maeve at Lantern Refuge.

stories.title: Lantern Refuge
stories.brief: Bring Tali to the refuge and use her map to plan a way in and a safe way out for the remaining scouts.
stories.outcome: Maeve will hold the refuge. The Wispkeeper points to the rootway, the hunting ground, and the old road beyond.

stories.title: The Ancient Rootway
stories.brief: Defeat Ancient Hollowbark and reconnect the inner rootway to the refuge.
stories.outcome: The rootway is open. Its ropes and lanterns give the missing scouts a return route through the forest.

stories.title: Venomcoil Crossing
stories.brief: Defeat Venomcoil King and mark a crossing that keeps the scouts out of the hunting ground.
stories.outcome: The crossing is secure. The last scout signals come from the edge of the queen's territory.

stories.title: One Brave Step
stories.brief: Free the last scouts, follow Finn's light, and hold off Hollowbark Sovereign while the group reaches safety.
stories.outcome: The scouts reach the refuge route while you hold the rearguard. Finn keeps the group together; the northern exit still lies beyond the queen.

stories.title: The Queen of the Webs
stories.brief: Defeat the Widow Queen, open the webbed northern exit, and check Tali's cargo marker.
stories.outcome: The scouts are safe and the northern road is open. Tali confirms the Crownheart cargo went toward Frozen Vale.

stories.title: Blizzard Gate
stories.brief: Follow Tali's lead into the valley. Help Freya rescue the stormbound travelers and relight the refuge trail.
stories.outcome: The travelers can reach Ember Refuge. Their relief supplies and broken village links need attention.

stories.title: Ember Refuge
stories.brief: Deliver relief supplies and help Haldor, Nessa, and Freya plan a crossing between the two village beacons.
stories.outcome: The refuge has medicine and a rescue plan. Restore the ravine crossing so the beacon teams can reach both sides.

stories.title: Wolf Ravine
stories.brief: Rescue the ravine keeper, restore the crossing, and relight both village beacons.
stories.outcome: The ravine crossing is safe, but the fortress alarm still drives the storm. Follow the signal line into the archive.

stories.title: Subglacial Archive
stories.brief: Compare the false warning with the guardian's behavior. Help Ylva restore the archive's shelter signal.
stories.outcome: The archive signal protects the refuge road again. The palace still repeats the false alarm; follow the cargo markers toward its fortress.

stories.title: Silent Battlefield
stories.brief: Identify the Crownheart sled marks and reopen the sheltered tunnel so Ivo can confirm their route.
stories.outcome: Ivo recognizes the cargo sleds. The tunnel gives travelers a way home while you approach the citadel locks.

stories.title: Frost Citadel Gate
stories.brief: Open both ice locks, carry the restored signal to King Ice Golem, and calm its remaining storm magic.
stories.outcome: King Ice Golem is resting. The palace road is open, but its final signal mirror still feeds the valley alarm.

stories.title: Ice Mirror Palace
stories.brief: Restore the palace mirrors, calm Queen Ice Elf, and end the false alarm across the valley.
stories.outcome: The storm eases and the villages reunite. Ivo's records lead to Ember Caldera, where the Crownheart was sent to be fitted into a portal-key frame.

stories.title: A Name in the Snow
stories.brief: Return the lost badge and luggage so Nessa can reunite Nell with their waiting friends.
stories.outcome: Nessa returns Nell's belongings. The arrivals board and the badge help the traveler find their waiting friends.

stories.title: Frostfang Supply Cave
stories.brief: Recover the stores from Frostfang Cave and calm the guardian blocking the hauling route.
stories.outcome: Freya can bring the recovered cave supplies to the refuge along a safe hauling route.

stories.title: Blue Lake Return Route
stories.brief: Check the abandoned lake-side stores and calm the guardian so Haldor can reopen the sheltered shore route.
stories.outcome: The shore markers connect Blue Lake to the refuge. Haldor has another safe return route for travelers.

stories.title: Ancient Glacier Watch
stories.brief: After the valley storm ends, calm the glacier watch guardian and inspect its old signal route for Ylva.
stories.outcome: Ylva has the peaceful watch record. The old glacier signal can guide travelers without restarting the false alarm.

stories.title: Ash Gate
stories.brief: Recover the freight-lift gear and help the stranded workers reach Forge City.
stories.outcome: The freight lift is working and the city road is open. Brann needs help bringing the trapped mine crew home.

stories.title: Forge City
stories.brief: Meet Brann and Ketta. Find the missing crew and prepare the tools needed to repair the city together.
stories.outcome: Orik knows the mine, Dagna knows the cooling flow, and Brann knows the protection relay. Rescue Orik and the miners first.

stories.title: Collapsed Resonance Mine
stories.brief: Brace the mine, stop the magma worm, and guide Orik and the miners to the safe exit.
stories.outcome: The miners can return to the city. Orik's map shows Dagna where the cooling channels have failed.

stories.title: Split Coolant Canals
stories.brief: Help Dagna restore the supply and return channels, then recover the complete safety-circuit plan.
stories.outcome: Coolant circulates again. The ancestral design vault holds the protection circuit needed for a safe restart.

stories.title: Ancestral Design Vault
stories.brief: Combine Dagna's inlet, Orik's return, and Brann's protection clues. Test their complete loop on the model.
stories.outcome: The model works because the whole crew helped. Take the repair kit to the testworks before restarting the great furnace.

stories.title: Geothermal Heart Testworks
stories.brief: Clear Magma Golem from the testworks and check that the repaired cooling circuit protects the city.
stories.outcome: The protected test succeeds. The crew can help you reclaim and restart the great furnace safely.

stories.title: Great Furnace
stories.brief: Use the repaired coolers, defeat Inferno Overlord, and reclaim the furnace. Check where the Crownheart cargo was sent.
stories.outcome: The city is safe. The Crownheart left before your arrival, but Veyr's dispatch reveals the royal tomb. Brann's route and Maeve's scouts open the approach to Haunted Graveyard.

stories.title: A Worker's Lost Mark
stories.brief: Return the lost work mark and safety record so Ketta can welcome Jori back to the crew.
stories.outcome: Ketta returns Jori's work mark. The rescued worker has their place on the crew board again.

stories.title: Ember Raider Nest
stories.brief: Recover the stolen freight from the raider nest and secure Ketta's collection route.
stories.outcome: Ketta can collect the stolen freight. The repair crew has its materials and a safe road back.

stories.title: Volcano Shaman Altar
stories.brief: Stop the shaman blocking the heat-altar service path and recover the crew stores left there.
stories.outcome: The heat-altar path is clear. Ketta's crews can reach the recovered stores without entering the old ritual ground.

stories.title: Caldera Titan Basin
stories.brief: After the furnace is safe, investigate the titan basin and secure the old ore-hauling route for Ketta.
stories.outcome: The titan basin's hauling route is recorded. The city can use its old freight landing again without delaying the royal-tomb mission.

stories.title: Mist Gate
stories.brief: Follow the route secured by the rescued scouts and meet Rook at the graveyard entrance.
stories.outcome: The scouts' lanterns connect Brann's approach to the keeper shelter. Gather with the allies preparing the assault.

stories.title: Friends at the Old Shelter
stories.brief: Learn the assault plan from Garrick, Eryn, Brann, and Elowen. Find out how Lumi can reach the inner gate.
stories.outcome: The scouts hold the approach, the elves guide the return path, and the dwarves ready the gate rig. Take Lumi's service passage to the winch.

stories.title: Lumi Secret Passage
stories.brief: Help Lumi reopen the keeper passage so you can reach the fortress-side gate machinery.
stories.outcome: The small passage reaches the winch, not the whole allied route. Secure Brann's gate so the crew can bring everyone through.

stories.title: The Alliance Opens the Gate
stories.brief: Secure the winch, stop Dread Commander, and answer Finn's signal to bring the allies through Brann's gate.
stories.outcome: Brann's gate is secured. The people you rescued hold your way home while you advance to the throne devices.

stories.title: The Black Throne Devices
stories.brief: Break the two outer shield links that block the route to Veyr's royal tomb.
stories.outcome: Both outer links are broken. The tomb approach is exposed, but Veyr still holds the Crownheart inside.

stories.title: The Royal Tomb
stories.brief: Clear the tomb guards and learn how Veyr's binding frame forces the Crownheart to power his invasion gate.
stories.outcome: The tomb seal is open and your retreat is secured. Defeat Veyr, release the Crownheart from his frame, then close the portal.

stories.title: Together We Bring Back the Light
stories.brief: Defeat Veyr, recover the bound Crownheart, and close the invasion portal before returning to Dawnspire.
stories.outcome: Veyr is defeated, the Crownheart is free, and the invasion portal is closed. Return to Dawnspire to restore the throne and meet your friends.
